description: The package stamp of a local or embedded com.unity.design-ui package: these files written into a package folder give this stamp in the MCP server (src/package-stamp.ts) and in the Unity package (DesignUi.Editor.PackageStamp). Paths sorted ordinally with /, per file "<path>\n<sha256 hex of its bytes>\n"; left out: names starting with . or ending with ~, and the top-level Tests folder.
